market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: This market resolves on official CME settlement (not intraday) — needs settlement >= $120 by end of June 2026. WTI front-month around $102-$105 currently with high vol from Iran tensions. To get a settlement at $120 = +15% from spot. Settlement requires close, not just intraday print, making this harder. Estimate moderate-low probability over ~2 months.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Major escalation could push settlement above $120; otherwise unlikely
